name: Lead Generator - reviewed source import TEMPLATE

parameters.content:
## Setup required — not a live crawler
1. Deploy Laravel and configure a strong import token.
2. Set an HTTP Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_TOKEN. Select it on the HTTP node. Never paste credentials into this JSON.
3. Replace example URL and mapping with your reviewed source.
4. Approve the source slug + exact listing hosts in config/leadgen.php.
5. Respect provider terms, pagination, data retention and rate limits.
6. Manual test first. 201 = created, 200 duplicate = already present. Errors stop execution.
Add an error workflow, batching, backoff and monitoring before scheduling. Keep execution-data retention minimal.
